requirements.description: User wants the nursery located near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.
The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area.
Energy class D or better (A1 through D). Energy score cannot isolate D, since E shares the same score of 3, so the class column is used directly.
